conviction_note: FY26 profit was already warned below expectations on 22 Jul, so the move sits in Tim Martin's first FY27 outlook paragraph and the new-year LFL. Since the warning-day close the stock is up 13.5% (722.5p to 822.5p), which prices a recovery (Panmure FY27 PBT £74.2m, +24%), while his last two results statements (FY25 prelim, FY26 interims) fell 5.6% and 10.6%. That gives a mild negative lean (p_up 43) on a full-size move (6.5%). The 4.57% short is flat and is the main reason the lean stays mild.

Free cash flow and buyback pace (6.4m shares bought YTD at £6.52, as of 22 Jul). Unknown

findings.finding: Since the 22 Jul profit warning the stock has rallied from a 722.5p close to 822.5p (year high 863p on 26 Aug), well above Panmure's 625p Hold target. That prices a FY27 recovery (Panmure FY27 PBT £74.2m, +24% on £60.0m), which the prelims' first FY27 outlook paragraph must now back, and Tim Martin's last two results-day statements have not done that.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Outlook and cost commentary on results days: FY25 prelim (3 Oct 2025, 'reasonable outcome' plus £60m labour cost list) -5.64%; FY26 interims (20 Mar 2026, 'slightly below current market expectations') -10.55%; Jan 2026 trading update -7.93%; 22 Jul 2026 pre-close warning -4.18% close-to-close (intraday -12%). Positive moves came only on May trading updates (+6.1%, +1.2%)
findings.original_quote: For the 2027 year now underway, she estimates sales of £2,319m, profits of £74.2m, earnings of 52.3p and a maintained 12p dividend per share.
findings.why_not_priced: The rally itself is the pricing: it has moved the stock toward a FY27 recovery that no company statement has endorsed. If the market expected a cautious outlook, the stock would sit nearer the post-warning 700p area and Panmure's 625p target, not 13.5% above the warning-day close.
findings.independence: The company's own cost lists in the interims (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/wetherspoon-j-d---jdw/interim-results/9483469) and the pre-close RNS (food, labour, repairs, energy, business rates). Reuters on the Iran-war energy squeeze and Panmure's 'more exposed' remark (https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/wetherspoons-fourth-profit-warning-hits-shares-cost-pressures-mount, 2026-07-22). The tape is Yahoo daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JDW.L?range=4mo&interval=1d)

findings.finding: The independent industry series cooled in the first weeks of JDW's new year: CGA RSM tracker managed pubs only +0.5% LFL in August 2026, down from +1.4% (industry) in July, as the World Cup ended and heat deterred drinkers. Peer Mitchells & Butlers' Q4 LFL was +1.4% to 19 Sep, so JDW's first-9-weeks LFL faces a softer backdrop than its +3.2% comparable from last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Current-trading LFL in results statements: FY26 interims carried a slowdown to +2.6% (7 wks) against H1's +4.8% and fell 10.55%. The FY25 prelim carried +3.2% (9 wks) against FY's +5.1% and fell 5.64%. A deceleration has been sold both times
findings.original_quote: The end of the tournament made August tougher for pub groups, as their sales finished only 0.5% ahead of the same month last year.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The tracker is public, but JDW has beaten it by ~3pts for 42+ months, so readers assume JDW is immune. The proxy carries little weight because JDW's own number can still land at +3-4%. A market that had priced softness would not have held the stock flat at ~810-820p through the tracker's release on 17 Sep (close 804.5p that day, 822.5p now).
findings.independence: Mitchells & Butlers 24 Sep 2026: Q4 LFL +1.4%, but August Bank Holiday weekend +5.3% (https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/mitchells--butlers-sees-fy26-in-line-with-consensus-as-sales-return-to-growth-4914482), which cuts partly the other way

findings.finding: A 4.57% disclosed net short (FCA, 28 Sep) has stayed flat (-0.01pt) through a 13.5% post-warning rally. Shorts have not covered, so a benign FY27 outlook would force covering in a name turning over only ~$1.1m a day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No squeeze has been observed on this name: every results-day move in the last year with negative commentary went down despite a short of similar size
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced as a level. This finding is the asymmetry: a squeeze needs an upside surprise to trigger it. It carries a small weight and offsets part of the negative lean.
findings.independence: FCA historic per-holder file (to 10 Jul 2026) shows GLG, Citadel, JPM AM, Mirabella and Premier Miton as 2026 sellers (https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/data/short-positions-daily-update.xlsx)

findings.finding: A person closely associated with Operations Director Martin Geoghegan sold 3,000 shares at £8.26 on 13 Aug 2026, ahead of the closed period. The other director transactions since are routine SIP and partnership-plan buys only.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public RNS but tiny (~£25k, 0.003% of shares), so it carries almost no weight. It is filed because it is a sourced insider act and there were no discretionary director buys at these prices.
